findings.reason: src/renderer.ts:307-324 now handles only text, image, html and breaks, so a code_inline token falls into `default: // all other tokens are skipped`. default_rules.image at :108-109 sets alt from this return value. The trigger is input like ![`diagram`](/x.png), which now renders alt="" instead of alt="diagram".
findings.claim: Removing the code_inline case from renderInlineAsText drops code-span text from image alt attributes.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes `case 'code_inline':` and its comment ("code content is added as plain text, without backticks") from the switch at src/renderer.ts:307-324. `code_inline` tokens, which backticks.ts:42 pushes inside image children, now reach `default: // all other tokens are skipped`, so their content is never appended. `default_rules.image` (src/renderer.ts:108-109) sets the `alt` attr from this function's return value, so every image whose description contains a code span loses that text.
